message:
Changelog

- IMPORTANT: This commit contains changes in some functions in `neurogym/core.py` that need to be thoroughly reviewed before merging.

- Cleaned up and simplified the logging in the `Monitor` class (`neurogym.wrappers.monitor`) (using the `logger` object importable as `neurogym.logger`).
- Added a monitoring system that allows the user to keep track of various parameters of one or more models.
    - The tracked parameters can be visualised in an interactive Bokeh-based tabbed panel in the browser.
    - Plots can be saved directly as PNG from the UI.
- Added a notebook (`example_neurogym_monitoring.ipynb`) to demonstrate how the capabilities of the updated `Monitor` class.
- Updated some directory and file paths in the `Monitor` class to use `pathlib` and the newly introduced timestamp function in `neurogym.utils`.

message:
Changelog

- IMPORTANT: This commit contains changes in some functions in `neurogym/core.py` that need to be thoroughly reviewed before merging.

- Cleaned up and simplified the logging in the `Monitor` class (`neurogym.wrappers.monitor`) (using the `logger` object importable as `neurogym.logger`).
- Added a monitoring system that allows the user to keep track of various parameters of one or more models.
    - The tracked parameters can be visualised in an interactive Bokeh-based tabbed panel in the browser.
    - Plots can be saved directly as PNG from the UI.
- Added a notebook (`example_neurogym_monitoring.ipynb`) to demonstrate how the capabilities of the updated `Monitor` class.
- Updated some directory and file paths in the `Monitor` class to use `pathlib` and the newly introduced timestamp function in `neurogym.utils`.

- Clarified some terminology:
    - 'modality' refers to a single type of signal
    - 'stimulus' refers to the actual signal that was presented, which could consist of one or more modalities.
- Updated AnnubesEnv initialisation arguments:
    - Moved `catch_prob` to the second position after session.
    - Renamed `stim_intensities` to simply `intensities` the former does not reflect the updated terminology.
- Simplified the logic of validating the session and extracting modalities. The validation method is now a class method so that it can be used as-is from the test functions for AnnubesEnv.
- Simplified the logic of preparing the stimulus from a set of options during a trial.
- Simplified the max_sequential checks and restored the default behaviour of not applying it to catch trials.
- Updated and fixed the tests for AnnubesEnv to reflect the changes in the environment.

message:
Changelog

- IMPORTANT: This commit contains changes in some functions in `neurogym/core.py` that need to be thoroughly reviewed before merging.

- Cleaned up and simplified the logging in the `Monitor` class (`neurogym.wrappers.monitor`) (using the `logger` object importable as `neurogym.logger`).
- Added a monitoring system that allows the user to keep track of various parameters of one or more models.
    - The tracked parameters can be visualised in an interactive Bokeh-based tabbed panel in the browser.
    - Plots can be saved directly as PNG from the UI.
- Added a notebook (`example_neurogym_monitoring.ipynb`) to demonstrate how the capabilities of the updated `Monitor` class.
- Updated some directory and file paths in the `Monitor` class to use `pathlib` and the newly introduced timestamp function in `neurogym.utils`.

message:
Added a metaclass to the inheritance tree to allow for checks to be performed after all base and derived classes have been initialised.
This allows us to check if the timing dictionary is empty *after* the object has been initialised.
Other checks can now be added in the custom `_post_init()` method, and different checks can be overridden in derived classes by passing the right arguments to `_post_init()`.

message:
Changelog

- Added `sb3-contrib` as a dependency (needed for recurrent policies, such as LSTM).
- Added `loguru` as a dependency (needed for logging output properly from multiple threads / processes).
- Added `pydantic-settings` as a dependency (needed for implementing the configuration system).
- Added a `config` module in the root directory to serve as a centralised configuration repository. The main configuration object (`conf`) and the main logger object (`logger`) are located in `config/conf.py`. The individual configuration components are located under `config/components`. The `conf` and `logger` objects are also exposed at the top level of the `neurogym` package, so they can be imported trivially (`from neurogym import conf` and `from neurogym import logger`).
- Added `mkdir` and `timestamp` functions in `neurogym.utils.functions`. The `timestamp` function can be used for organising logs hierarchically by date and time.

message:
Changelog

- IMPORTANT: This commit contains changes in some functions in `neurogym/core.py` that need to be thoroughly reviewed before merging.

- Cleaned up and simplified the logging in the `Monitor` class (`neurogym.wrappers.monitor`) (using the `logger` object importable as `neurogym.logger`).
- Added a monitoring system that allows the user to keep track of various parameters of one or more models.
    - The tracked parameters can be visualised in an interactive Bokeh-based tabbed panel in the browser.
    - Plots can be saved directly as PNG from the UI.
- Added a notebook (`example_neurogym_monitoring.ipynb`) to demonstrate how the capabilities of the updated `Monitor` class.
- Updated some directory and file paths in the `Monitor` class to use `pathlib` and the newly introduced timestamp function in `neurogym.utils`.

author: cantordust <43831101+cantordust@users.noreply.github.com>
message:
- Updated AnnubesEnv to handle multiple modalities properly.
	- Moved all session processing logic to a separate method and added extra checks to ensure that the session dictionary is formatted properly. All elementary stimulus types are extracted as well and assigned to the `stim_types` attribute.
	- Moved all max_sequential checks into a separate method.
	- Added the ability to present multiple stimuli simultaneously.
- Catch trials are now handled like any other modality. This vastly simplifies the logic of deciding what to present during the trial (whcih could be a catch trial).
	- As a side effect, it is also straightforward to handle the restrictions on the maximal number of sequential presentations imposed via `max_sequential` (solves #88).

Configuration update

- Removed directives in `.gitignore` to ignore TOML files in the code tree.

- Abstracted the logger into its own module (`conf/logging.py`).

message:
Changelog

- Added `sb3-contrib` as a dependency (needed for recurrent policies, such as LSTM).
- Added `loguru` as a dependency (needed for logging output properly from multiple threads / processes).
- Added `pydantic-settings` as a dependency (needed for implementing the configuration system).
- Added a `config` module in the root directory to serve as a centralised configuration repository. The main configuration object (`conf`) and the main logger object (`logger`) are located in `config/conf.py`. The individual configuration components are located under `config/components`. The `conf` and `logger` objects are also exposed at the top level of the `neurogym` package, so they can be imported trivially (`from neurogym import conf` and `from neurogym import logger`).
- Added `mkdir` and `timestamp` functions in `neurogym.utils.functions`. The `timestamp` function can be used for organising logs hierarchically by date and time.

author: Jeff Royer <jeffrey.royer@gmail.com>
message:
Ensure the bat file will work on Windows

The bat file previously used colons to separate class path arguments,
however Windows uses semi-colons to separate class path arguments.
Change the colons to semi-colons to address this issue since bat files
were meant to run on Windows. Also remove some of the arguments since
the paths probably don't make sense for a Windows machine.

Additionally, add a sh file to be used to run CCDD on non-Windows
machines.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added a node, 'All tables' to the table trees whenever the tree is
filtered by group so that non-grouped tables are available for
selection. Corrected telemetry scheduler table tree initialization to
use the default rate filter. Added script access methods to get the
columns names belonging to a command argument, and for getting a command
argument value based on the column name. Reverted the script data access
class to non-static and created a new class with duplicate, but static
methods that call the non-static access methods - this supports
scripting languages that require either non-static or static methods.
Changed so that imported and exported child tables must include the
complete path. Updated CSV import so that all empty trailing columns are
ignored. Corrected handling of excess column information in a CSV import
file. Moved addTablePanes() call in loadTableDataInBackground() to
complete() section so that it occurs in the EDT. Changed the pseudo
group containing all tables so that is can be selected in a script
association. Changed check for existing tables when importing so that
child tables are handled (and prototypes more efficiently). Changed the
database verification so that the internal tables are reloaded following
an update (making the changes available without restarting). Changed the
import operation to utilize the save point feature (for reverting is an
error occurs). Included save point handling when the application is
closed by killing the process. Updated import methods to handle
unrecognized input types. Consolidated handling of user response to
import errors into a single method. Changed so that when importing from
a CSV file any trailing blank columns consisting of pairs of quotes
(with or without intervening spaces) are ignored. Added a check for a
valid applicability when importing a data field definition. Created an
import support class for common import methods, and included the error
response, data field validation/addition, and new table type
validation/addition. Corrected restoration of original table types,
macros, etc. when an import operation fails. Changed to allow line feed
insertion (by typing Alt-Enter) into a table cell that allows multiple
lines. Changed table editor so that multi-line cells automatically
resize to fit the cell contents as text is added or removed. Changed
database verification to use a table editor handler to generate the
table updates (in place of duplicating the code). Corrected condition
where a table row can be emptied of values and the now empty row is
stored in the database instead of being deleted. Added tutorial and
accompanying script. Updated user's guide and CCDD.jar.

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added undo/redo to the group manager's Groups tree and the link
manager's Links tree. Corrected group manager data field edit so that
the currently editing field is undone first. Corrected data table paste
so that pasting over an array doesn't cause the last pasted row to be
skipped. Changed data table paste so that for each row the columns that
will receive blanks are pasted first, then the columns that will receive
a non-blank value. Added undo/redo buttons to the group manager. Added
calls to end the edit sequence if the focus changes within the data
field panel (allows the undo/redo calls to operate idividually). Added
resize event listeners with invokeLater() calls to the group manager,
table editor, and table type editor so that the data field panel has the
correct size for the WrapLayout manager.  Updated the field editor to
resize the caller if a data field wider than the caller is created.
Consolidated the undoable component handlers into a single class.
Included description field undo/redo capability in the link manager.
Moved the edit panel resize listeners to the edit panel handler. Changed
so that if an invalid value is entered into a data field the original
value is restored. Added undo/redo capability for data field
addition/modify/deletion in description/data field panels (used in the
table editor, table type editor, and group manager). Removed in
buildModificationCommand() where backslashes were added to bracket
references in the variable path replacement string. Changed
buildModificationCommand() so that changes to variable names and/or data
types (only) use a regular expression to alter all array members versus
creating a command for each array member (this reduces the number and
size of the modification commands). Added check of table and variable
references in the internal tables to the database verification. Changed
to allow special characters (e.g., apostrophes) in the project database
description. Corrected prototype table rename so that open editors are
updated. Corrected server name reference in the event log. Changed so
thatt the database name isn't checked for being a dup[licate when
updating the open database's description. Updated the undo handling so
that structural changes to data fields can be undone/redone. In the data
field editor changed to insert a blank value for separators and breaks
to prevent an exception. Updated keyboard handler for data field editors
and modal dialogs. Corrected application scheduler duplicated
application tree entries.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
*** NOTE: This version alters a project's database schema. Earlier CCDD
versions will be incompatible with the updated database and vice versa
***

Changed handling of table type data fields so that inheritance by tables
is strictly enforced. Inherited fields may only be edited in the table
type editor's field editor. Adding, modifying, and deleting fields for a
type affects all tables of that type. Separator and break fields are not
inheritable (Github issue #44). Corrected table import so that the list
of all tables has newly created prototype table names added to it; this
prevents SQL commands to create a table that already exists (which would
result in an error) (Github issue #48). Corrected
buildModificationCommand() so that a change to the custom values table
value column is delimited properly to prevent issues with special
characters. Corrected variable tree creation; in table tree handler's
buildNodes() method moved the addition of the child node to the parent
node so that it occurs prior to getting the child node's full variable
path. Added a failure message to the login dialog if an invalid user
name or password is entered. Changed the exit value to always be '1' if
the application exits abnormally when executed from the command line.
Changed the table type editor Fields menu to allow four overwrite values
types (overwrite all, overwrite if value is the same, overwrite if value
is empty, and don't overwrite). Changed the patch handler to have two
sections - patches to apply prior to initializing class handlers and
patches to apply after initializing class handlers. Corrected missing
table type data fields in CSV exports. Moved the Overwrite values
sub-menu in the table type editor to the Fields menu. Updated Javadoc,
user's guide, and CCDD.jar.

Corrected the update indicator associated with the table type editor

table, command table, and telemetry scheduler message IDs are not
duplicated. Updated the menu item key mnemonic setter so that the
occurrence of the character to highlight can be specified. Added a
command button to the telemetry scheduler that allows removing variables
of a specific rate from the telemetry messages. Changed the
determination of message IDs in use to include tables that do not
represent a structure or command.  Updated the use's guide and .jar
files.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Version 1.0.56. Added variable paths as an option when exporting tables.
Changed the web access commands for macros and variable paths to be case
insensitive and to allow a semi-colon as a separator. Changed the
variable path dialog to retrieve/store the separator characters in the
program preferences. (in work) Adding an input type that aloows the full
variable path to be displayed in a structure table column. Added input
type that allows a variable path to be displayed as a column in a
structure table. Corrected undo in the lik manager for link tree
selections by discarding edits after all initialization completed.
Changed buildPathAndOffsetLists() to use
INSTANCE_STRUCTURES_WITH_PRIMITIVES in place of
STRUCTURES_WITH_PRIMITIVES so that prototypes of child structures aren't
included. Corrected the structure/variable offsets/sizes list by
removing references to child prototypes while building the lists.
Changed the project rename so that the currently open project can be
renamed. Changed the telemetry scheduler assignment tree to show the
root table names in alphabetical order. Changed to preserve
capitalization in project names (this includes a patch to update
existing projects; the changes are backwards compatible). Added
automatic selection of a group (link, telemetry scheduler message,
application scheduler time slot) when a table (variable, variable,
application) is selected in the group (link, variable, application) tree
in the group manager (link manager, telemetry scheduler, application
scheduler). Added a web access command to provide the currently open
project's name, lock status, description, and user. Corrected reference
to isTableChanged() in the table editor handler to override the one with
ignoreColumns. Added check for null retunr from getNodeByNodeName() in
copyPrototypeTableTreeNode() that can occur when importing a table.
Changed modifyTableData() to accept flags detrmining if the description,
column order, and/or data fields are to be updated. Changed database
verification to retain the macro names when inserting new rows.
Corrected database verification insertion point of missing array
members. Updated .jar file.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected display issue in the table manager dialog where the tree
resized when the single file check box was selected. Changed the XTCE
and EDS export dialog so that single file output is required. Added
check to the table manager dialog so that a directory isn't accepted
when a single file is required. Added default fields to the structure
and command table types for new projects. Changed the Edit table(s) and
Export dialogs to allow selection of the header node one level above the
table level. Corrected loss of Group and Link manager table/variable
tree vertical scroll bar. Corrected Group manager resize to too narrow a
width. Changed table editor store so that empty rows are retained in the
editor. Changed check box font in New Group dialog. Corrected exception
caused by inserting a new row into a table (wrt to variable paths).
Updated the project field dialog to automatically adjust height to keep
all fields visible during resizing. Updated XTCE and EDS export (import
in these formats is no longer supported). Updated protobetter script.
Updated CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated scripts. Corrected show/edit data field table editor to handle
sorting of the rows by column header selection (affected opening tables
and field removal flags). Changed the input type for the CFS application
default data fields for wake-up IDs (two) to be message IDs so that the
auto assignment detects them, and changed their initial values to 0x1.
Corrected the group manager where applying a filter to the group tree,
then selecting a node in the table tree caused a null pointer exception
(account for group tree level change). Corrected the telemetry scheduler
where selecting a table from the variable tree and an option, then the
right arrow (assign) button caused a null pointer exception (account for
node deselection). Added dialog to display a table containing every
message ID name and its corresponding message ID and owner.  Added a
script access method to get an array containing every message ID name
and its corresponding message ID and owner. Changed so that path names
are ignored when sorting the script associations table using the Script
File column and the paths are hidden. Corrected the group manager so
that the field information is initialized when there are no groups.
Added an UndoableArrayList class for use with the group and link
information and incorporated it into the group and link managers'
undoHandlers. Updated sample JavaScripts so that the script data access
methods that return arrays are handled as array objects in the scripts.
Changed the group manager's automatic highlighting of groups that have
as a member the selected table from the table tree to use the current
group tree state instead of the committed group information (accounts
for unstored updates). Added highlighting of a group if multiple tables
are selected and all of the selected tables are in the group. Added
restoration of the group/link tree node's expansion when members are
restored via undo/redo operations. Corrected script manager for row
sorter error when no rows exists in the table. For undoable tree edits
set the isAllowUndo false while undo/redo operations are in effect.
Updated command line help for execute command. Updated sample scripts.
Updated user's guide and CCDD.jar. Updated ITOS page sample script for
JavaScript and added versions for Groovy, Python, and Ruby.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated undoable text area and text field so that changes to the text
are reported to the owner as they occur (this is the same as is done for
table cell edits; this allows the owner's change indicator (*) to be
added/removed as text is amended). Corrected the telemetry scheduler so
that the correct Scheduler table message and byte size are updated if a
variable is added and the Scheduler table has been sorted. Corrected the
telemetry scheduler so that the Scheduler table message name is selected
when an variable is selected, an option chosen, and the right arrow
button pressed (the message name selection was only occurring if a cell
in the Scheduler table was already selected). Added filter check boxes
to the data field table editor so that the type(s) of data field to
display can be altered (data field types include project, table, group,
and table type). Updated user's guide. Updated CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected error in displaying structure table names in a structure table
data type column. CCDD.jar updated only

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Removed check for table change in the custom setDataVector method so
that edits are correctly placed on the edit stack.  Updated the user's
guide and .jar file.

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added undo/redo buttons to the group manager. Added calls to end the
edit sequence if the focus changes within the data field panel (allows
the undo/redo calls to operate idividually). Added resize event
listeners with invokeLater() calls to the group manager, table editor,
and table type editor so that the data field panel has the correct size
for the WrapLayout manager.  Updated the field editor to resize the
caller if a data field wider than the caller is created. Consolidated
the undoable component handlers into a single class.  Included
description field undo/redo capability in the link manager.  Moved the
edit panel resize listeners to the edit panel handler. Changed so that
if an invalid value is entered into a data field the original value is
restored. Added undo/redo capability for data field
addition/modify/deletion in description/data field panels (used in the
table editor, table type editor, and group manager).  Removed in
buildModificationCommand() where backslashes were added to bracket
references in the variable path replacement string. Changed
buildModificationCommand() so that changes to variable names and/or data
types (only) use a regular expression to alter all array members versus
creating a command for each array member (this reduces the number and
size of the modification commands).  Added check of table and variable
references in the internal tables to the database verification. Changed
to allow special characters (e.g., apostrophes) in the project database
description. Corrected prototype table rename so that open editors are
updated. Corrected server name reference in the event log. Changed so
thatt the database name isn't checked for being a dup[licate when
updating the open database's description. Updated the undo handling so
that structural changes to data fields can be undone/redone. In the data
field editor changed to insert a blank value for separators and breaks
to prevent an exception.  Updated keyboard handler for data field
editors and modal dialogs.  Corrected application scheduler duplicated
application tree entries.  Corrected error in data type update to
account for bit lengths in the __links and __tlm_scheduler table
variables.  Added the number of issues detected to the project
verification results dialog.  Added number of search results to the
search dialog.  Corrected display of JavaScript version number in the
About dialog.  Added a cancellation dialog with progress bar to the
project verification operation.  Iproved speed of project verification.
Updated the data type and macro editor change implementation to increase
the speed of the update process when only the data type name or macro
name changes, or when the data type size changes but the new size is not
larger.  Updated .jar file

author: Jeff Royer <jeffrey.royer@gmail.com>
message:
Ensure a Command Argument can be added to a Command

Inserting a new row in a command and selecting a command argument will
cause an error when storing the changes. This occurs in the function
modifyInternalFieldsTable when checking the data type column of the
table. However, the Command table does not have a data type column, and
an exception gets thrown.

Address this specific issue by checking if the data type column exists
before trying get the row data.

Fixes #83

applicability 'Parents only' to 'Roots only'; a patch was added along

Applicability column. Corrected "squashed" rows in a table editor
following a table type update.Updated doTableModificationComplete() in
the table editor dialog to append the variable name to the structure
data type in the invalid table editor list for both modifications and
deletions.  Updated closeDeletedTableEditors() to adjust the matching
pattern based on if the variable name is included. Adjusted the padding
in the PaddedComboBox class. Added a check for a null cellEditor in the
table editor handler's prepareRenderer.  Added check that a structure
data type exists when double-clicked to open. Corrected closing of

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
