order. The order of the JSON information is made to match the order in
which it is stored; therefore, the order is consistent from export to
export, allowing differences to be more easily detected (e.g., using
diff) (this is related to GitHub issue #52). Changed loadTableData() so
that it checks the variable handler's structureAndVariablePaths list to
determine if a table path exists, not just the table's prototype.
Changed so that sort() calls use compareToIgnoreCase() rather than
forcing the comparison strings to lower case and using compareTo().
Updated Javadoc and CCDD.jar (version 1.4.72).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated the table search method to cover the case where changes are made
by the user to the table and then the next/previous button is pressed.
Added replace, replace/search, and replace all buttons to the table
search dialog. Changed so that is a value is entered into an array
definition column that requires unique values then the value isn't
propagated to the array members. In the table handler's scrollToCell()
method (which was scrollToRow(), but this has been changed to include
the column and the former scrollToRow() calls the new method) added a
second call to scrollRectToVisible(), outside the invokeLater() call.
Updated the table export dialog so that the single file check box is
ignored if not present. Changed so that the descriptions wrap for the
radio button and check box grid dialogs as the dialog is resized.
Changed the check box and radio button dialog methods to include a flag
to display the description column using an italic font (LABEL_ITALIC).
Corrected project verification table data storage to keep committed and
updated arrays separate. In the table editor's openChildTable() method
changed so that the macros in the committed data are expanded when
comparing to the expanded data from the table itself. In the unlock
dialog changed the comparison of the project name to use the database
version of the name so that associated user names are detected. Updated
the link manager so that the special node icons are displayed in the
variable tree (the removal of the header node caused the icon detection
to not recognize the structure node level). Corrected the script
handler's storing of the variable path in the table data array - the
removal of the HTML tags caused the embedded line feeds to be removed
(these are needed to parse the table members); for this can the line
feeds are retained. Changed the variable handler so that array
definition paths and offsets are stored in the lists (since the array
definition path/offset can be requested by the scripts). (in work)
Updated the table editor so that when a variable name, data type, or
array size is changed the variable path column (if present) is populated
by the updated path (and not blanked). Updated CCDD.jar. Updated ITOS
page scripts.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected errors associated with adding padding variables. Added a
progress/cancellation dialog while adjusting the padding variables.
Changed the project verification progress/cancellation dialog to display
the current verification step. Corrected calculation/storage of the
alignment boundary when set via the dialog.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added new input type, Number. Cleaned up warning and error messages (in
work). Added call to updateVariableReferences() following an update to
the input types so that the structure paths and variables list is
restored. Removed EDS and XTCE .java files from CCDD.jar. Updated
CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed table editor cell validation so that cells containing sizeof()
in an expression aren't replaced by the expression evaluation (e.g.,
'sizeof(float) + 1' is not replaced by '5') - this is now identical to
how macros are treated. Changed so that cells not containing a macro or
sizeof() call are not evaluated as expressions; the expression parser
(mxParser) treats a large number of text strings as defined constants
(e.g., 'pi', 'e') which produced unexpected results (e.g., trying to
name a variable 'pi'). Added a numerical sort comparator to the data
type editor's Size column (was sorting alphabetically). Added column
input type-specific sort comparator to the data table editor so that
columns that only allow numbers are sorted numerically, not
alphabetically. Changed the table editor so that buildUpdates() doesn't
process the variable path column when the editor isn't displayed. Added
check in modifyTables() so that if the command is empty no event is
logged. Changed the call to getTableTreePathArray() in
isStructureShared() to only use the paths from the 'Parent & Children'
node. Changed the data field editor so that the Size value is stored in
the cell as an integer. Replaced instances of
'Integer.valueof(text.replaceFirst("0x",""), 16)' with
'Integer.decode(text)'. Where sorting of a String[] list is performed
changed List<String[]> variables to ArrayListMultiple and used the new
sort method. Changed the message ID assignment dialog to use input
verifiers for the fields in place of overriding the dialog handler's
verifySelection() method. Corrected errors in the ITOS record scripts.
Implemented a sort comparator for the table editor based on the column
input data type. Added a hexadecimal sort comparator for Scheduler
table's ID column.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed how variables following child structures are aligned when
assigning padding variables. Updated CCDD.jar (version 2.0.8).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added a check box to the script manager and executive dialogs to
show/hide unavailable associations. In the export dialogs made Single
file the default and changed so that the file name is added/removed when
selecting Single/Multiple. Changed group manager so that the table types
are always included in the group tree ('solves' the problem of the table
members getting changed by selecting, then deselecting the table type
filter); removed the table type filter check box. Updated Javadoc,
user's guide, and CCDD.jar (version 1.5.8).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Replaced the math expression parser mxParser with a simpler evaluator.
Updated CCDD.jar.
*** NOTE: Padding is currently broken; use of the padding feature can
corrupt the database. The issue will be corrected in the next release
following this one.

author: Bryan Willis <bryan.willis@uky.edu>
message: Updating CCDD to version 2.0.26

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message: Corrected the patch handler to retain internal table row order.

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected a bug that can prevent some of the SQL commands from executing
when modifying a table type definition.

author: Bryan Willis <bryan.willis@uky.edu>
message: Updating CCDD after addressing the table tree expansion issue and refactoring the assign message ID functionality.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
*** CUSTOM INPUT TYPES ARE STILL CONSIDERED EXPERIMENTAL ***
Added validity check for regular expressions in custom input types.
Changed so that open editors' cells with custom input types are
refreshed (if the value is no longer valid then it is blanked). Updated
CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated the Export dialogs so that the multiple/single radio buttons
aren't displayed if exporting via the table editor dialog. Changed the
table tree so that the filter nodes (by group, by type), when enabled,
appear prior to the 'Prototypes' and 'Parents & Children' nodes. Added
menu items for opening the recently opened tables to the table editor
dialog's File menu (shows the same list as is shown in the main window's
Data menu). Updated the script manager so that a change in a group's
members (via the group manager) is reflected. Changed the table tree
handler so that the filter check boxes match the tree node configuration
if the tree is altered. Eliminated code that would have prevented
entering a rate or enumeration in an array definition. Added code to
prevent entering a value in an array definition column flagged as having
unique values (however, this change may get reverted). Changed the
telemetry scheduler dialog to adjust the assignment tree display width
to accommodate long tab (message) names when these are updated. Removed
the "Structures & Variables" node from the link manager (the structures
and variables now descend directly from the root or filter nodes).
Corrected sizeof() so that primitive variables are allowed. Added a
search dialog for text in an open table or table type editor, including
the capability to jump the cell selection to the next or previous match.
Updated the user's guide and CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added an input type for non-zero hexadecimal vales and applied it to the
CFS application wake-up ID data fields. Updated the data field input
verifier so that if the first field update is invalid the value reverts
to the initial value rather than a blank. Updated the application
parameter dialog (e.g., "slots per message" is now "messages per time
slot"). Updated the application scheduler script access methods and
Python script, and added JavaScript, Groovy, and Ruby versions. Updated
CCDD.jar and the docx version of the user's guide.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added capability to override individual XTCE export methods via script
functions so that the output can be tailored for a particular user's
needs; this allows a script to perform some or all of the XTCE
conversion using the script association process or via the export
dialog. Added script data access methods in support of the XTCE
conversion and an example JavaScript script that duplicates the internal
methods. Changed the script data access handler so that the group and
link handlers can be loaded 'on demand'. Added a file selection button
to the XTCE export dialog for selecting the export script. Updated the
user's guide to include XTCE export method override via script
functions. Updated CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected Search tables results Owner column for data fields to display
the owner instead of the fields name. Updated CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed so that file paths may contain environment variable references
(e.g., $HOME). Added temporary overriding of environment variables in
script association paths via an input field in the script manager and
script executive; the override variables are stored as a program
preference. Updated EDS export. Added table type editor command to
insert a set of default command argument column definitions into the
currently displayed table type. Added array size and bit lengths to the
predefined associated columns class. Added script access methods for
command argument bit length and updated those for command argument array
size.  Added command argument array size and bit length to the web
access output. Corrected update of project field dialog change indicator
following a Store operation. Added (new) XTCE import capability (this
eliminates the ancillary data used extensively in the older import
code). Updated data field input panel resizing to correct a condition
that can cause a field to wrap without resizing the parent component.
Changed XTCE import to store the application ID and command function
code argument column names as ancillary data during export. For import
these are read in; if not present the project's field values are used,
and if not present default values are used. Split the Classes class into
two classes, one for components and one associated with tables and data.
Added drag and drop functionality to tabbed panes (table editor dialogs
allow dragging tabs between the dialogs; other tabs stay within the
original container). Reverted changes made to creating table type
database column names. Added ability to drop a table editor tab outside
of an editor dialog so that a new editor dialog is created.
Updated/corrected rate parameter dialog input verifier method. Corrected
redraw of rate parameter and message ID assign dialog buttons if an
invalid input is in the field being edited when the Okay button is
pressed. Corrected where the script manager association table displays a
new association as unavailable (grayed out). Added check in the table
editor validateCellContents() method to prevent pasting in a data type
that matches the table name. Changed Delete table(s) command to allow
selection of a header in the table tree. Updated handling of data fields
when a table changes its root structure status. Added check to the table
cell validation to prevent pasting in a structure data type that would
result in a circular reference. Changed so that field applicability is
applied only when creating the data field panel for display (otherwise a
structure table's field information list retains all fields, regardless
of applicability, that belong to it; this resulted in extensive internal
changes but simplifies field handling overall). Corrected data field
panel resizing when adding new fields. Updated the show/edit fields
table so that group and table type fields for the same group/type are
displayed on the same row in the table. Changed so that the data type
lists for all open table editors are updated when a table is modified.
Updated the user's guide and CCDD.jar. This is version 1.2.0.

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected an issue where the rate parameters weren't determined when the
SQL functions are created. This resulted in no rate columns being
detected for inclusion in the functions.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected JSON import/export issues and loadTableData() table existence
check. Updated CCDD.jar (version 1.4.75).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added script access commands for project-level field names, values, and
descriptions. Updated user's guide to include project-level data fields
and access commands. Corrected link and telemetry scheduler table
updates that were accidently deleted. (in work) Verifying and updating
table modification and deletion command builder methods. Updated
CCDD.jar.

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added JSON as an import/export format. Changed group manager to also
copy the data fields when a group is copied. Added script data access
method to get a data type's base type based on the data type name.
Changed the ITOS encoding type script access method to return an
unsigned integer for pointer data types.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added capability to import/export script associations (GUI and command
line). In the event log status message displaying the command line
arguments enclosed arguments with double quotes that contain a space.
Updated validity check for imported macros, data types, and input types.
Updated createSearchPattern() to handle reserved characters. Updated the
group and link managers to eliminate excessive calls to check for
group/link changes when updating the dialog's change indicator. Updated
Javadoc, user's guide, and CCDD.jar (version 1.5.3).

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message: Corrected jaxb-api reference in Ant build file. Rebuilt CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated the C structure to CSV conversion utility to correctly handle
the definition of multiple pointers in a single statement.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added option to overwrite or insert data and fields when importing a CSV
file into an open table editor (in work: other import formats to
follow). Updated undo/redo handling of imported data so that the import
is undone/redone as a single edit.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected file chooser dialog so that a file name entered without an
extension only has an extension applied if the chooser is filtered to a
single file type. Added missing HTML tags to the data field import
mismatch error dialog message. Corrected erroneously reported group
import mismatch (changed getTableMembers() calls to
getTablesAndAncestors() in order to preserve the full table path).
Corrected loss of embedded leading and trailing white space characters
for a quoted, multiple line text input in a CSV import file. Updated
CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed the table search dialog to display the selected columns to which
to constrain the search (if any). Changed the serach dialogs from a
CcddDialogHandler object to a CcddFrameHandler object to prevent window
stacking issues with non-modal dialogs that can spawn other dialogs.
Changed the key handler so that the Enter key does not toggle check
boxes and radio buttons (to allow it instead to actuate the default
button in the associated dialog). Changed the table print method to
center the native print dialog over the table top-level ancestor
component. Updated the dialog setLocationRelativeTo() method to account
for multiple screens. Corrected database name references to use
lowercase form for PostgreSQL operations. Added unanticipated exception
catch in some of the database table methods. Changed modifyTableType()
so that if the table type doesn't exists it skips code only relevant to
existing table types. Corrected modifyTableType() so that a new type
doesn't cause an exception. Added capability to assign a description to
a script association. Changed script associations to display in a table
instead of a list. Modified the internal associations table schema,
which requires a patch to existing project databases. Changed script
manager to allow editing an association's description within the
associations table. Corrected script manager and executive so that an
unavailable association can't be executed and so that unavailable
associations can be selected (for removal purposes) in the script
manager. Moved call to reset_link_rates() PostgreSQL function from
deleteTableCommand() since it is invalid for a query command. Changed
the assoications table patch to update the table even if no associations
are stored. Changed to handle the addition and deletion of string array
members with respect to the links and telemetry scheduler tables.
Updated event log to get the correct row when opening a specific row and
a row filter is in effect. Corrected link manager so that string array
members are moved together betwen the variable and link trees. Moved the
link updates for string arrays from the table editor handlr to the
database table command handler. Corrected link and telemetry scheduler
table update changes for string array member addition/deletion.
Corrected link and telemetry scheduler table update changes for
primitive variable deletions. Updated script association selection to
account for sorting of rows. Added a check box to toggle between showing
and hiding the scipr file paths in the script associations table.
Corrected the script access method getCopyTableEntries() to handle macro
expansion. Added methods to retain macros in the script access methods
for getting table paths by row. Added the search dialogs to those that
are updated when a look & feel change is made. Created a program
preferences dialog and moved the look & feel selection to it; added
ability to update fonts, colors, size values, and spacing values.
Updated program preferences dialog appearance. Added more program color
preferences. Updated the JFontChooser appearance. Updated all tool tip
text strings to wrap to the user-definable number of characters.
Corrected search results array comparison method to eliminate an illegal
argument exception. Corrected server name auto-complete storage
reference (was storing to search strings). Cleaned up source code
formatting and program preference descriptions. Updated user's guide and
.jar file.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added a maximum limit to the width of a data field. Added an input type
for a multi-line data field. Added a web access method to perform a
database search. Modified the search_tables() function to add the
capability to use a regular expresiion in a table/log/script search.
Updated the user's guide and .jar file.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed so that the search for user-defined variable path replacements
is skipped if no table type contains a variable path column definition
(prevents an exception condition). Combined variable size and conversion
handlers to eliminate having two lists of full variable paths. Changed
buildDeletionCommand() to reduce the number of commands for deleting a
variable. The new method takes into account that the pattern for the
variable name can be reduced to a regular expression that detects all
variable instances (old method specifically sought out each instance of
the variable). Added capability to add project-level data fields.
Corrected command line script execution. Updated CCDD.jar.

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message: Move Javadocs; add CCDD docs.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added alert if a default data field name will force existing table
fields to be renamed (user can allow or cancel update). Added event log
messages when an import begins and if it fails (import completion event
already exists). Changed command line handler to remove bounding single
or double quotes from each command line argument (this is done already
by Linux, and is done already for double quotes by Windows, so the
effect of this change is to allow the use of single quotes around
arguments in Windows or other OSes that behave similarly). Updated
CCDD.jar (version 1.4.50)

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message: Corrected input type table column order mismatch. Updated CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected duplication of data field definitions when importing a table.
Changed so that imported tables inherit the default data fields from
their table type definition. Changed so that prototypes created from
child tables during import do not inherit the child's data fields.
Updated Javadoc, user's guide, and CCDD.jar.

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message: Version 2.1.7. Corrected an exception when starting with the GUI hidden.

author: Bryan Willis <bryan.willis@uky.edu>
message: Updating CCDDv2 to version 2.0.22

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed the creation of the variable name conversion list so that
multiple lists are maintained (maximum is user-definable; default is
10). A new list is created if an existing one doesn't use the supplied
separators. Scripts, such as the ITOS record script, may require
variable paths with differing separators - maintaining multiple lists
reduces execution time by not having to recreate the same list numerous
times. Changed the loadTableData() method so that an invalid table
produces a log entry and error dialog (previously the error was detected
and simply set the error flag). Updated the user's guide and CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected group manager - when adding a new group the table type nodes
are added (tables were not allowed to be added unless the new group was
stored, then the group manager reopened). Changed SQL command execution
to better handler an interrupted server connection. Updated Javadoc and
CCDD.jar (version 1.5.19).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated CCDD.jar (fix for variable size/conversion handler
initialization in table command handler class)

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated the find/replace dialog to allow a backslash to escape a wild
card character. Restored the find/replace dialog's storage of the search
text field contents in the remembered search strings (for
auto-completion purposes). Updated the table search dialog so that
variable paths in the search result table's context column have the
matching search text highlighted. Changed the JTable handler so that
each cell gets its own cell renderer (as opposed to sharing the same
renderer for cells of the same type). Added a variable search dialog
that allows searching for text in the variable paths and displaying the
results in both tree and table form. Changed the order in which table
data is concatenated when running a script association so that the
tables of the same type are in the order as established in the
association. Updated the Javadoc and CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added a call to roll back to the save point if an error occurs applying
a macro or data type change. Added code in getAssociationTablePaths() to
create the table tree when needed. Updated CCDD.jar (version 1.5.17).

author: Bryan Willis <bryan.willis@uky.edu>
message: updating javadoc files again, but this time using java 11 rather than 8 in an attempt to remove all frames.

author: Bryan Willis <bryan.willis@uky.edu>
message: Updating jar and users guide.

author: Bryan Willis <bryan.willis@uky.edu>
message: Data types not being populated correctly.

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
CCDD Version 2.1.12 amendment; added check to prevent asking to apply a
patch for a new database. Updated Javadoc.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Github issue #50: In CcddMain(), when the GUI is hidden, changed so that
the result of the openDatabase() call and a comparison of the targeted
and opened project names (in case the user specifies a project and it
downmodes to the default, postgres) determines the exit status.

Github issue #52: The non-root prototypes are left out when using the
command line export.  When exporting from the dialog all tables in the
'All tables' group node in the table tree are included.  The command
line export doesn't have a tree with selected nodes; it must parse a
string of tables, so it uses a method in the script handler for this
purpose.  This method started with root (not prototype) tables, and then
added child tables.  The method was altered to include the prototypes as
well.  In addition, the script handler's method didn't automatically
include ancestors as does the export dialog's method, so this was added
in the script handler method (when using the method for exporting, not
when handling a script association).

Github issue #54: Moved the code that does the macro updates to
createTablesFromDefinitions() from importFile() since the code to store
to macros to the database was occurring prior to making the updates.

Updated Javadoc and CCDD.jat (version 1.4.57).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added script access methods for getting the data field names associated
with a table, table type, or group, and to get the description for a
specified table. Added a change indicator to the script manager if there
are unstored changes. Updated the show/edit data field dialog to
indicate a change when a field is flagged for removal. Corrected row &
column coordinates (view vs model) used in the show/edit data field
dialog.  Changed the show/edit data field dialog so that if no fields
are available the selection dialog is not displayed (including if all
fields are flagged for removal and the change is stored). Added check
(and correction) for valid input data types in the database verifier.
Changed table trees that only display prototype tables to not show the
'Hide data type' check box. Updated the user's guide and CCDD.jar.

author: Bryan Willis <bryan.willis@uky.edu>
message: Quick fix for 2.0.27

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected loading of table columns with boolean values in the __values
table. Updated CCDD.jar (version 1.5.33).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected typo in typesHeader scripts. Added check to table type editor
to prevent using a column name that matches a PostgreSQL key word.
Corrected data base verification flagging of invalid input types.
Updated delimiting of strings written to database so eliminate possible
conflicts with the string. Changed the input type editor so that the
match column is grayed out if selection items are entered (the match
regular expression is built to reflect the selection item list). Added
capability for data fields to use the selection item input types. Added
validation of cells and fields for input type changes (a blank is
substituted for the cell/field value for a type mismatch). Simplified
handling of an input name change and when forcing a cell/field value to
blank due to an input type match change. Changed the scheduler handler
and script handler to use the halt dialog class; added a progress bar to
the script execution dialog. Removed unused code.  Update the user's
guide (work remains). Updated CCDD.jar.

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message: CCDD version 2.1.13. See README.md for details.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated the find/replace dialog to better track the number of matches
and to set the replace button icons. Updated the table editor's
getVariablePath() method so that it returns a variable path when the
user changes the variable name, data type, or array size (each of these
alters the variable's path; the stored list in the variable handler
doesn't contain the new path until the Store button is pressed so it
returns a blank). Changed the XTCE and EDS libraries so that the XML
tags in exported files are prepended with 'xtce:' and 'seds:'
respectively. Updated CCDD.jar.

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added Jetty version information to the About dialog. Changed the About
dialog to highlightthe labels. Added code to display the version number
when executed from within the IDE. Changed the event log seqrch key to
Ctrl-F. Changed to remove any HTML tags from the default rate in the
link manager and telemetry scheduler. Updated the SQL function
find_prototype_columns_by_name() to force the table name to lower case.
Altered the major dialogs/editors/managers to set up the dialog in a
background thread, then display upon completion of set up.

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message:
2.1.4 beta: Corrects highlighting of matching search text in data tables
when using the find/replace dialog, scrolling a data table to a
specified cell (for example, when using the find/replace dialog), a
table export bug that caused XTCE exports to throw an exception, and a
bug that results in mis-ordering of the table paths when getting the
list of paths from a table tree (this affects the order that table data
is loaded when executing a script).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed show/edit data field dialog so that inapplicable fields are not
displayed. Changed HTMLCellRenderer so that only the fort row's column
is HTML tagged if not already. Disabled patches #01262017, #07112017,
and #07212017. Corrected backup path when applying a patch to account
for having no preference set for the backup path. Added auto-completion
capability to table cells and data fields using an input type having
selection items. Added an input type that displays a selection list
containing all of the project's variables (the format hides the data
type portion of the variable path). Updated CCDD.jar.

author: Bryan Willis <bryan.willis@uky.edu>
message: Quick fix for error that occurs when adding a new argument to a command table.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated telemetry scheduler's Scheduler table headers. Moved updating
message names & IDs following storing changes to the telemetry scheduler
to the doSchedulerupdatesComplete() method to prevent a race condition.
Changed the method that converts view column names to database
equivalents so that the default names are only used for certain
structure table columns (and not command tables). Altered the table type
editor to allow both 'primitive' and 'primitive & structure' input types
for the command argument data type columns. Corrected the 'show all
message IDs' method and the script access method
getTelemetryMessageIDs() to handle sub-messages. Added table path/name
format verification when importing. Corrected data field owner name for
tables when importing CSV files. Removed duplicate listener for EDS
export. Updated user's guide and tutorial. Updated CCDD.jar.

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected search dialog and query to properly account for special
characters. Added check for a file name in the import dialog. Changed
the import methods to allow an ignore/ignore all/cancel response to
errors. Added a generic catch method for unanticipated exceptions. (in
work) Adding enumeration response to table member query

author: Bryan Willis <35711309+bawi235@users.noreply.github.com>
message: Update README.md

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added command line options to create and delete a project (Issue #35).
Added capability to use wild card characters in the log, table, script,
and web access searches. Changed importing a table type so that if the
database has a type with the same name the existing type is overwritten
if no tables exists that use the type. Updated Javadoc, users guide, and
CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed EDS, JSON, and XTCE imports so that a parsing error results in
an exit status of 1 when importing from the command line with the GUI
hidden (GitHub issue #62). Added call to recreate the database temporary
table if the server connection is dropped and then reestablished.
Removed debugging print statements. Updated Javadoc, user's guide, and
CCDD.jar (version 1.5.6).

author: WILLIS, BRYAN <bryan.a.willis@nasa.gov>
message: When exporting a database the folder that the files are being exported to will be cleared of any existing files.

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected exception caused when calling SchedulerDbIOHandler's
getStoredData() method with a valid stream name, but the stream has no
messages. Corrected the web access method for retrieving the copy table
information to use the data stream name instead of the rate column name.
Added option to expand variable name macros when retrieving the copy
table information using the script and web access methods. Added script
access methods to retrieve group table members and group data fields.
Changed the text and button for the dialog that halts script execution.
Changed so that halting script execution is logged as script execution
failure. Updated the user's guide and .jar file.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected warning message for missing data table column(s) to display
the correct column name. Updated undo handler for data fields so that a
copy of the field information is used for undo/redo operations. Updated
import of data into an existing table for XTCE import files. Updated
project verification handling of a bad SQL command so that the changes
are reverted properly. Corrected project verification (1) insertion of a
missing array member if it's the last variable in the structure, and (2)
initial loading of the dummy table editor for building updates. Added
stripping of the message ID auto-assignment protection flag (trailing #)
from any message ID returned by a script data access method. Added web
access method to get the list of message ID owners, names, and values.
Updated user's guide and CCDD.jar.

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected issue in script manager association table verification
(structure tables without variables were not included, so these tables
were considered missing and the association was grayed out).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Replaced the update_data_type_names() SQL function with SQL statements.
When restoring a backup the REVOKE and GRANT commands that specify an
owner other than PUBLIC have the owner name replaced with the specified
project owner (current user if no owner is specified); also ignore
COMMENT ON EXTENSION command for pgpsql due to owner issue. Updated
CCDD.jar (version 1.5.13).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated EDS library. Corrected undoable check box and text field
internal naming to account for child table owners. Changed the data type
handler to return 1 for a string size in bytes. Updated the table editor
handler's doTableUpdatesComplete() method to simply it and to better
handle uncommitted changes to tables affected by the original change.
Changed key shortcuts to eliminate duplicate keys in the same context
and to standardize similar menu/button operations to use the same
shortcut. Implemented padding feature for byte
alignment. Updated user's guide and CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed the number of displayed combo box menu rows a preference value.
Corrected input type combo box blank item display. Corrected script
executive and manager display of disabled associations.  Corrected
script executive to use table model versus displayed table to get the
availability. Updated CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added call to buildPathAndOffsetLists() to update the variable paths
list when deleting a structure table type or modifying a structure table
type such that it no longer is a structure. Changed the itosRecFile
scripts to eliminate the expected 'Name' portion in the enumerations
('Display Name' remains); also improved testing for missing fields.
Updated the dialog handler methods for adding check boxes and radio
buttons to set the scroll pane size even if the scroll bar doesn't
appear initially. Changed the executeScript() method's catch statement
to encompass any exception (an 'array out of bounds' exception in the
script threw an Exception, versus a ScriptException, in 64-bit Java; no
error was thrown in 32-bit Java). Cleaned up dialog messages. Updated
CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected macro expansion for macros containing two or more expressions
separated by commas. Updated CCDD.jar (version 1.5.31).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected issue when a table cell ends with '$' and the '$$' delimiter
is used (now uses the '$_$' form for the delimiter). Updated CCDD.jar
(version 1.5.34)

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected multi-line data fields to adhere to the width constraint
(Github issue #39). Changed the 'create' and 'delete' command line
command priorities (delete before create). Changed the so that when the
GUI is hidden the log version of a fail event is output to the command
line versus the shorted dialog box form. Corrected CSV and JSON group
import so that 'Group:' isn't prepended to the group name. Changed tree
filtering for highlighting data types so that any data type in the
branch is affected (not just the leaf node). Corrected/updated filtering
of table and information trees (by type, group, app; Github issue #36).
Changed the group filter check box so that it's active when no
user-defined group exists, making the 'All groups' pseudo-group
available (Github issue #40). Corrected command table bit length columns
so that these are grayed out if the corresponding data type column
doesn't contain an integer type (Github issue #41). Changed table
handler so that it repaints immediately for a cell change. Updated
Javadoc, user's guide, and CCDD.jar (version 1.4.31).

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message: CCDD version 2.1.13.  See README.md for details.

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message: Remove read_me.md

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected handling of data fields when importing from a CSV- or
JSON-formatted import file (includes applying default fields to new
tables; Github issue #44). Eliminated the check for missing or extra
data field inputs when importing from a CSV-formatted file. Updated
Javadoc, user's guide, and CCDD.jar (version 1.4.42).

author: bawillisJSC <77999883+bawillisJSC@users.noreply.github.com>
message: Update README.md

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed to indicate unrecognized column data for JSON, EDS, and XTCE
import files.  CHanged to ignore data type and macro definitions, and
data fields during import into an existing table

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected the path parser in FileEnvVar to enclose the path name portion
in Pattern.quote() when used in the regular expression (Github issue
#59). Added the -nottimestamp option when creating the Javadoc (the
eliminates the time stamps and makes locating differences between old
and new Javadoc files easier; Github issue #60). Added the javadoc.xml
Ant script. Updated Javadoc and CCDD.jar (version 1.4.97).

author: Bryan Willis <bryan.willis@uky.edu>
message: Changed the syntax of the code and changed the regular expression that represents what names are valid for macros.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected table editor handler's pasteData() method with respect to
array members. Updated CCDD.jar (version 1.4.52).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added a 'select all' check box to the search table dialog's column
selection dialog. Updated the 'select all' check boxes so that these are
updated to match the selection states of the associated check box items.
Changed the search table dialog's column selection dialog to display the
visible column names (vs the database names) in the label underneath the
column selection check box. Corrected the dialog handler's
addCheckBoxes() method to set the isDescprition flag (inadvertently
deleted). Changed so that data fields are properly inherited by a new
child table from its prototype table. Corrected the script manager so
that duplicate associations aren't added (HTML tags caused a comparison
issue). Corrected the table tree's getSelectedTablesWithoutChildren()
and getTablesWithoutChildren() methods header node level comparisons
(should be '>=', not '>'). Added an applicability check to the input
field panel handler when updating field values from the components to
prevent accessing non existent components. Added a regular expression
validity check for the find/replace search text. Added wild card
capability to the find/replace dialog.  Updated the tutorial and user's
guide (.docx only). Updated CCDD.jar.

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed the script data access methods getParentTableNames(),
getParentCommandTableNames(), and getParentStructureTableNames() to
getRootTableNames(), getRootCommandTableNames(), and
getRootStructureTableNames(), respectively.  Deleted the single table
methods getParentTableName(), getParentCommandTableName(), and
getParentStructureTableName().  Moved the call to
schedulerInput.updateVariableTree() in the scheduler handler auto-fill
run() method to the complete() method to prevent a race condition
resulting in an array index out of bounds exception in the variable
tree. Added an argument array size column to the default command table
type. Change the script data access method to get the variable paths to
use the variable conversion class and to return the path as a single
string instead of an array of path references. Updated the scripts to
use the current script access method calls. Made minor edits to the
user's guide. Changed table type editor to prevent introducing multiple
input types that must be unique for the structure and command types.
Updated the user's guide and .jar file. Updated so that the Field |
Clear values command (table editor, table type editor, group manager)
can be undone/redone.  Updated undo/redo (menu, button, and key
sequence) for the table editor, table type editor, and group manager so
that the data field background colors are correctly set. Changed the
Message IDs | Find duplicates command: sort duplicates by message ID,
eliminate repeated owners, include the original owner, add a Print
button, and show the telemetry message rate as well as name. Changed
structure table to not allow assigning a message ID to an array
definition. Changed getRateInformation() to sort the list by data stream
names.  Corrected link manager to update a copied link's rate and size.
Corrected the link manager copy and delete commands to update the
variable and link trees following a copy/delete operation. Changed the
link copy failure dialog to use a table to display the list of links &
members not copied. Updated user's guide and .jar file.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated script access method getStructureTablesByReferenceOrder() to
account for pointers to structures. Updated CCDD.jar (version 1.5.28).

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed the Import data command to store the file if the import
succeeds.  Corrected JSON table type export to remove HTML tags from the
column names.  Corrected the application scheduler to handle when no
applications are defined and altered the default application parameters
to legal values.  Changed the patch method for the table types table to
perform the database backup in the same thread.  Changed PDF save
options in Word so that the user's guide opens without errors from the
Help menu.  Updated the user's guide.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected message ID assignment so that the table types and groups are
updated if more than one of the assignment dialog tabs is checked (the
same update flag was erroneously used for each without use of an |=).
Corrected message ID assignment so that tables not currently open in an
editor are updated (the field information in the field handler was not
updated prior to storing the information in the database). Corrected the
data field show/edit table editor to account for the field information
being persistent in memory (recent change).  Updated Javadoc and
CCDD.jar (version 1.4.38).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated XML (EDS & XTCE) import and export - command headers are
converted to structures during import. Added calls to set up the rate
information following an XML import. Cleaned up code formatting.
Completed updates to allow importing EDS and XTCE formatted files,
including importing into an existing table so that the arrangement of
the existing table's type definition are used to assign data to the
table columns. Updated CCDD.jar.

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message: Version 2.1.4a. This corrects the bug described in issue #103.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed table modification so that SQL commands that used OR'd
conditions are now issued as individual commands (significant postgres
speed improvement). Changed links and telemetry scheduler table updates
to detect array deletions so that a single command can be constructed to
remove all array members. Updated cFE command and telemetry structure
CSV import files. \Added utility to convert selected cFE and CFS apps
telemetry and command structures to CSV format for importing into a CCDD
project. Added tables produced by this utility. (in work) Adding
capability to evaluate macro formulae. Updated the utility method
splitAndRemoveQuotes(text) to separate on commas, including any
surrounding white space characters. Updated getParts() method in the web
data access handler to allow white space characters between query items.
Implemented the open source math expression parser mXparser
(http://mathparser.org) to allow math expressions in macros and array
index column cells. Updated CFS to CSV conversion utility to read input
paths from a file. Moved structure and variable size methods from the
links handler to a separate class; new class is instantiated when the
project is opened and is updated when changes are made to structure
tables or data type definitions. Changed the macro editor to allow
insertion of a macro via a pop-up (Ctrl-M). Corrected the data type
editor's structure pop-up. Added code to prevent recursive macro
expressions. Added macro highlighting in the macro editor's value
column.  Added sizeof() highlighting in the macro editor's value column
and the table editor's array size column. Added display of macro
expansion in a tool tip to the macro editor. Incorporated sizeof()
expansion in the macro handler. Changed to allow macro expression
expansion to include comma-separated integer expressions (for use with
multi-dimensional array sizes). Added a table tree for filtering to the
variable paths & names dialog. Moved the display of the number of
variables in the variable paths & names dialog from the dialog header to
above the variables table. Added Ctrl-Shift-M support (to display all
macro expansions) to the macro editor. Added Ctrl-S support to display a
pop-up of data types in the data tables and macro editor. Added
prevention of circular sizeof() references. Corrected log search to
enable searching other than the session log. Corrected
modifyTablePerDataTypeOrMacroChanges() to use view coordinates when
calling isCellEditable(). Corrected handling of group filtering in the
telemetry scheduler's variable tree wrt disabling used linked variables.
Changed the table search to highlight data types in table paths. Updated
macro handling to store expanded macro values and reevaluate the macro
value only when a change occurs. Updated user's guide and CCDD.jar.

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message:
Version 2.0.30: Corrected JSON and CSV single/multiple file import and
export bugs.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated initial sizing of dialogs containing radio buttons and check
boxes. Updated CCDD.jar.

author: Bryan Willis <35711309+bawi235@users.noreply.github.com>
message: Update README.md

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added a command line option to include/exclude build information (CCDD
version, project name, host, and user name) when exporting. Changed the
build information for CSV and JSON exports to use the project name
instead of the database name. Corrected a null ResultSet error when
reconnecting to the server/database following a dropped connection.
Improved speed of group tree updates (adding/removing tables and
applying filters). Updated Javadoc, user's guide, and CCDD.jar (version
1.5.4).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed how variables following child structures are aligned when
assigning padding variables. Updated CCDD.jar (version 1.5.32).

author: Bryan Willis <35711309+bawi235@users.noreply.github.com>
message: Update README.md

author: Kevin McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message: Create README.md

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected number format exception if array deleted that has a macro in
its array size (macro wasn't expanded).  Added capability to flag child
structure values so that they revert to using the default from their
prototype table. Updated the user's guide and .jar file.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected display of new group node name in group manager (ellipsis was
shown; added call to node.setPreferredSize(null) in group tree
gettreeCellRendererComponent()). Corrected new group node's expansion to
hide the empty table tree nodes (call groupTree.setheaderNodeEnable() in
the group manager's newGroup() method). Corrected so that the CFS
application fields are added when a group is created with the 'is CFS
app' check box is selected (use the field information directly and not a
copy). Updated CCDD.jar (version 1.5.22).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected table type handler comparison of input types (can't use '=='
since these are no longer enums). Corrected handling clean-up following
an attempt to open a non-existent database when the GUI is hidden.
Corrected call to getDatabaseLockStatus() from the command line import
command to use the database (vs project) name. Updated Javadoc and
CCDD.jar (version 1.4.50).

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed the link manager and telemetry scheduler so that the rate filter
values that are unused are grayed out and unselectable. Corrected the
table type editor input type column so that grayed out types are
unselectable. This includes the addition of two new PostgreSQL functions

Updated JTableHandler to replace the TABLE_CHANGE_EVENT property change
event with a placeholder method. The method is called with invokeLater()
to ensure all other table changes are handled prior to calling the
placeholder method. Changed the various editors to override the
placeholder instead of listening for the TABLE_CHANGE_EVENT

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated table editor creation via tab dragging to add the recent table
menu items. Update the message reference item list to include messages
with no name. Updated the message list to sort on name, ID, then owner
(or owner, ID, then name depending on usage).  Added variable, command,
and message pop-up combo boxes. Changed the pop-up combo box to a
generic class for use by the macro, data type, variable, command, and
message pop-ups. Added ability to use the pop-up combo boxes in
description and data fields. Updated Javadoc and CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added capability to import macros with the same name but different
value. If the user hasn't elected to replace the existing value then a
dialog is displayed allowing for the mismatch to be ignored (retaining
the original value) or the import stopped. Added data field inheritance
for child tables created by changing a macro value used as an array
size. Corrected the import method so that actual copies are made of the
original data (and not merely references). Updated users guide and
CCDD.jar (version 1.4.55).
(in work) Adding automatic child table inclusion for XTCE and EDS
export.

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message: CCDD version 2.1.8 (updated).  See README for details.

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added export and import of table type data fields to the JSON format.
Reformatted the table editor tabbed pane tool tip text.  Changed the
export dialogs' so that (de)selecting the single file check box doesn't
alter the path/file in the input field.  Changed database connection so
that a null result from getting the database comment prevents continuing
to open the selected database.  Changed reading of the version and date
from the .jar's manifest to include the .jar's full path.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added creation of a disabled undo handler in the link handler when a
null undo handler is passed to it. Corrected the script handler so that
child tables are loaded only once, and in the order as defined by the
table's type (root tables are sorted alphabetically). Changed the trees
displaying tables and variables to highlight the data type portion of
the tree node name (if present).  Added a check box to toggle display of
the data type portion of the tree node name (if present) in the table
and variable trees.  Updated CCDD.jar.

author: Bryan Willis <35711309+bawi235@users.noreply.github.com>
message: Update README.md

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Added auto-complete to the database host text fill.  Added tool tips
showing the complete script path in the script manager and script
execution associations lists.  Changed the script manager and script
execution associations lists to show only the script name even for
associations created in other OS's.  .jar file NOT updated
(in work) Adding update to associations when a table is renamed or
deleted.

Updated table and table type editors so that change indicators
(asterisks) are moved from all tabs when the 'Store all' command is
performed.  Corrected update of table editor tab names if a prototype
table is renamed.  Updated PostgreSQL command used to alter data table
names in the internal tables. 
Added updating of script associations in the __associations table when a
table is renamed or deleted.  Corrected handling parsing an association
when the association has no tables.

Corrected isTargetInTablePath() so that it stops searching only when a
match is found. Corrected the script manager to highlight all tables in
the tree that are in a selected association. Incorporated a check for
bit-packed variables when updating internal tables following a change in
a variable's bit length. 

Changed table tree to display table arrays in correct order (by array
dimension indices). Updated PostgreSQL function to account for a macro
in the array size where the macro value is blank. Corrected setting of
keyboard mnemonics for menu components. 
(in work) Corrected inital height for dialogs containing tables

Corrected random height sizing of the data type and macro editors.
Corrected exception due to invalid column index in data type and macro
editors. Changed data type and macro editors to allow deletion of an
empty row. Added the table tree and script associations in the script
manager to a split pane. Changed the dialog handler's check box and
radio button array methods to set the number of initial rows.

Added web access command to authenticate user login.  Updated table
addition, modification, and deletion methods with respect to updating
references to structures in the internal tables to cover edge cases,
changes of a table from being a root to being a child table, updates to
the links and telemetry scheduler tables, etc.  Updated user's guide and
.jar file.

author: bawi235 <35711309+bawi235@users.noreply.github.com>
message: Update README.md

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected file chooser dialog so that folder-only selection doesn't
truncate folder names with spaces. Added a program preferences tab for
folder paths. Added methods to set (program preferences and command
line) and get a script output file path for use in the scripts.
Corrected script association parsing for when no table is associated.
Updated sample scripts. Changed so that the default database (postgres
server) is opened when changing the database server. When changing
servers the host, port, and SSL state are unchanged until after the
current database is closed (in order for the log entries to show the
correct server, etc.). Added SSL connection capability. Corrected text
field auto-completion so that it is disabled for setText() calls. Added
the server host information to the Databse User selection dialog. Added
a preference item for changing the grid width for radio button and check
box dialogs. Adde a separate path for the session log and for loading
previous logs. Changed storage of folder paths. Changed the Program
Preferences dialog's Path tab so that when a Select button is pressed is
goes to the folder currently shown in the input field instead of the
current program preference path since the path may have been changed
while the dialog is open, but not yet stored. Corrected so that
PostgreSQL functions are created when the database is opened. Updated
component spacing in the preferences dialog. Updated database
verification to recognize groups in script associations. Added copy
table creation method that accepts an array of tables with message IDs
and added corresponding script access methods. Updated user's guide and
CCDD.jar file.

author: WILLIS, BRYAN <bryan.a.willis@nasa.gov>
message: Trying to improve performance by extracting required libraries from the jar file.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>

Corrected tool tip text for input type combo box in the data field
editor. Updated Javadoc and CCDD.jar (version 1.4.75).

author: Bryan Willis <bryan.willis@uky.edu>
message: Addressed a few small bugs within version 2.0.25 and updated the required documents.

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message: Version 2.0.35.  See README.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected exception if a table referenced by a group doesn't exist in
the database. Added capability to read user input from the command line
for question dialogs when the GUI is hidden. Added a check box to the
CSV and JSON import dialogs and a command line import command
sub-command to ignore import errors (for errors that can be ignored).
Placed the 'show project fields' dialog description and data fields into
a scroll pane. Added a maximum display row constraint and vertical
scroll bar for multi-line data fields. Corrected exception when
importing via the command line when the GUI is hidden. Corrected display
of the group icons when the group tree is filtered by application.
Changed the group manager table removal to allow selection of a header
node (all tables under that header are removed). Corrected/updated group
tree filtering by table type so that all structure tables are displayed
under their corresponding type header (even if an ancestor is of another
structure type).  Updated Javadoc, user's guide, and CCDD.jar.

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message: Version 2.1.4 release. See README.md for changes.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected JSON export to not invert the 'replace macros' selection.
Moved the Halt dialog to its own class. Changed the command line
commands that set a path to only change the path for the current
session. Changed the scriptOutPath command so that it can be used more
than once in the command line. Added code in the ITOS record file
scripts to account for a missing 'System' data field. Updated the user's

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>

Corrected the command line usage text for the 'delete' command. Changed
the command line 'delete' command 'noMessage' sub-command to
'continueIfMissing' (now exits on error if not set). Changed so that
command line processing stops immediately if an error occurs. Changed so
that the database lock isn't altered when the database is opened when
the GUI is hidden. Changed so that the database is opened in the
foreground when the GUI is hidden. Changed so that an error is

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message:
Version 2.0.33. Incorporated further improvements to storing table
updates in the database.

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message:

author: Kevin McCluney <rmcclune@nasa.gov>
message:
CCDD version 2.0.34:
* The Table Type Editor dialog converts a user-defined column name to
one that meets the PostgreSQL constraints when creating the table in the
database. The constraints are that the column name contains only
lowercase letters, numerals, or underscores, and only begins with a
letter or underscore. The conversion replaces any 'illegal' characters
with an underscore (example: A@b.com is converted to a\_b\_com). CCDD
erroneously allowed a leading numeral in the database version of the
column name, causing table access errors. A column name with a leading
numeral now has an underscore prepended (example: 1\_is\_the\_name is
converted to \_1\_is\_the\_name)
* A scale factor input is added to the Preferences dialog Fonts tab. The
scale factor is applied to all font sizes. Fractional values are
allowed. Scaling is useful when using high definition monitors in
operating systems (e.g., certain Linux versions) that don't apply font
scaling to all applications
* A fixed, or 'frozen' column can be enabled in the Table Editor. The
first column displayed is duplicated and displayed to the left of the
table. If the table is scrolled horizontally the fixed column remains in
position. Dragging another column to the first position changes the
fixed column to the duplicate this new column
* Restored the Show Variables dialog

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Overhauled data field handling - the field handler is now persistent and
global. Changed the auto-complete combo boxes to instead allow typing a
match string (with optional wildcard characters) to prune the list.
Changed the halt/progress dialog to not bring it to the front each time
the progress bar is updated. Corrected the filtering on the variable
name & path dialog. Added a command information dialog and input type to
display all commands. Added major contributors to the About dialog. Made
further additions to the command information dialog and command
reference input type, and added update of fields/cells using the input
type if a command table is modified, renamed, etc. Consolidated the list
updates required after adding, renaming, copying, or deleting a table
into a common method. Added code to the boolean cell renderer to prevent
a potential class cast exception (if the table cell is blank). Added an
override method for setControlsEnabled() in the script manager to set
the Store button's status based on the user access level. Added a call
to repaint the table in the padded combo box's ComboBoxEditor's
setItem() method to account for a table update issue. Consolidated the
table opening method used by various editors' Open buttons into a common
TableOpener class. Updated the static script access methods to match the
current dynamic access methods. Added script access commands to get all
command information. Corrected handling of item matching combo box item
removal/replacement for lists without an initial blank item, and to
account for lists containing HTML tags; changed to automatically display
the item list when the combo box receives focus. Eliminated the
enumeration input type as a requirement for a structure table. Added the
minimum and maximum input type columns as defaults for s structure
table. Change handling of enumeration, minimum, and maximum input types
to queue off the input type's format so that selection item lists can be
used for these input types. Updated the input type editor for handling
of the value format for input types using a selection list. Corrected
the data field editor to allow setting an applicability for the
separator and break field types. Updated the user's guide (docx only)
and CCDD.jar. Added automatic updates of cells and fields using the
message name & ID input type. Corrected project copy to use target
database to determine admins. Added check to determine if a project has
any command tables when updating the command information list. Updated
the XTCE import/export to correctly set the ending index for an array.
Changed the command reference list to display the visible table name.
Corrected data field handling: changed the field handler, input field
panel handler, table editor, table type editor, and group manager to
keep the fields separate and updated. Changed table cells using the
Message Name & ID input type to display all of the message information
(name, ID, and owner). Added updating of table cells and data fields
using the Message Name & ID input type when a message name or ID is
changed. Included Javadoc documentation. Corrected drop down menus to
stay the width of the longest list member. (in work) Correcting field
handling for adding new fields. Corrected so that data fields can be
added. Changed the command information sort to use a method compatible
with Java 7 (and subs). Updated so that padding variables are ignored
when assigning message IDs. Corrected padding to load descendant
prototypes when not all tables are adjusted. Added validation of the
regular expression used as a table or script search string. Updated
CCDD.jar. Implemented new input type that combines message names and IDs
(existing separate input types are removed; added patch to convert old
message name and ID references). Corrected data field handling. Added a
progress dialog to the message assignment operation. Updated user's
guide and CCDD.jar.

author: WILLIS, BRYAN <bryan.a.willis@nasa.gov>
message: This commit addresses multiple issues with the CCDD patch handler. When the patch is applied to a CCDDv1 database all of the arguments in the 'Command' table type are removed and placed in a newly created table type called 'Structure: Cmd Arg x'. During this process many of the non-required fields like the 'Description' field were being cleared, non-required table type columns were being flagged as required, too many unnecessary/duplicated table types were being created and too many data columns were being added to the newly created table type. This commit also addresses a naming issue that was occuring during the patch.

author: rmcclune <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated the command line handler to allow multiple 'execute' commands.
Corrected table editor so that non-structure table rows can be moved up
or down. Changed event log to send error messages to the command line if
the GUI is disabled. Corrected initialization of the web server from the
command line so that the JSON handler is initialized after the project
database is opened. Changed the web server table size command to allow
child table names to be parsed. Changed the script association handling
and execution to allow child tables (tables with paths). Updated the
associations list to gray out child table references if the child does
not exist. Adjusted the padding for boolean (check box) data fields.
Changed the data field table editor to display boolean data fields as
check boxes. Changed JTableHandler to reset the hiddenColumns list when
table data is reloaded.  Changed command line handler to prioritize
commands. (in work) Changing script handling to account for child tables
Changed undo manager so that data field editor changes are expunged when
the data fields are recreated.  Editors changes so that a change
indicator (asterisk) is displayed in the editor title or tab if unstored
changes exist. Updated the boolean input type to accept true or false
only.  Updated the data field table editor to display boolean fields as
check boxes. Changed edit panel so that check box data fields are
undoable/redoable. Updated the edit panel handler so that a data field
addition/change/deletion updates then owner change indicator.  Changed
the keyboard handler so that undo/redo function properly for data
fields, the macro editor, and the data type editor. Updated the
telemetry scheduler message option list code so that rate's < 1 sample
per second generate the appropriate message/sub-message combinations.
Removed references to Pattern.quote() is SEARCH function calls.  Changed
the links manager to display an * in a data stream tab if that stream
has any unstored changes. Added unstored changes indicator (*) to group
manager, data type editor, macro editor, and data field editor. Update
table and table type editors to use isTableChanged() to determine if
unstored changes exist. Eliminated the scheduler validator,
auto-validation menu item, and validate buttons in the schedulers.
Updated the table modification method to update the telemetry scheduler
table.  Added event log method that allows setting the error dialog
title.  Added command line command to set the file path for the event
log.  Updated the telemetry scheduler so that changing a message name
correctly updates the assignment tree. Corrected telemetry scheduler so
that if no message is selected the add sub-msg button is ignored.
Changed the application and telemetry schedulers to indicate if there
are unstored changes. Corrected a bug in deleteTableCommand() and
modifyTableType() to account for the rate and a separator preceding the
table name in the __tlm_scheduler table.  (in work) Changing
modifyTableType() to account for all permutations of changing the column
name and/or rate input type Changed the table type editor so that the
input type combo box items and the displayed columns are updated when a
change is made to a cell. Corrected the tabbed editor dialogs to use the
widest table to set the dialog width. Corrected table deletion to update
the telemetry scheduler table.  Changed the telemetry scheduler table's
separator character. Modified table type updates to correctly handle if
a type becomes a structure or if it is no longer a structure (including
rebuilding the SQL functions). Changed the table editor to update the
'special' column indices when the table's type is altered. Changed web
server 'telemetry' and 'command' requests to allow macro name retention.
Updated web access 'telemetry' command to include variable description
and units.  Added "Reset order' command to the table editor dialog.
Corrected ColumnEdit undo() method.  Corrected modify table type
complete actions to only discard edits for the table type that is
updated.  (in work) Adding macro on/off to web access 'telemetry' and
'command' commands.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed the data field handler to be global & persistent (in place of
numerous individual handlers). This resulted in changes throughout the
code. Changed the Restore data base command to not be affected by user
access level. Corrected the field editor to use the current (versus
committed) field information. Changed table cell combo boxes to allow
the up & down arrows to function so as to allow selection from the combo
box list. Updated the Show/Edit Fields table to account for selection
lists (combo box) cells and to correct handling of boolean (check box)
cells. Corrected handling of the Table Manager dialog system close
button. Added capability to reconnect to the database server and retry a
database transaction in the event a transaction fails due to a lost
connection (e.g., due to a temporary network drop out). Added capability
to open the owning table for a data field from the search results table
in the data table search dialog. Changed the auto-complete combo boxes
to instead allow typing a match string (with optional wildcard
characters) to prune the list. Changed the halt/progress dialog to not
bring it to the front each time the progress bar is updated. Corrected
the filtering on the variable name & path dialog. Added a command
information dialog and input type to display all commands. Added major
contributors to the About dialog. Made further additions to the command
information dialog and command reference input type, and added update of
fields/cells using the input type if a command table is modified,
renamed, etc. Consolidated the list updates required after adding,
renaming, copying, or deleting a table into a common method. Added code
to the boolean cell renderer to prevent a potential class cast exception
(if the table cell is blank). Added an override method for
setControlsEnabled() in the Script Manager to set the Store button's
status based on the user access level. Updated the user's guide and
CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Updated EDS handler so that the exported files pass a validation test
against the schema. Changed so that when a dialog spawned from a frame
is closed its owner is brought to the top of the window stack (currently
causes a brief flicker if the frame is already on top). Corrected
handling of multiple table references in an script association executed
from the command line. Changed so that project databases backed up under
PostgreSQL 8.4 or earlier can be restored in PostgreSQL 9.0 and subs
without causing an error due to creating the plpgsql language. Updated
XTCE export to remove aggregate references. Changed XTCE export to make
all descendant tables of the telemetry header as child space systems of
the telemetry header space system. Updated XTCE export to account for
the command header structure table having child tables. Updated the
XTCE.jar and EDS.jar libraries so that the XML tags are prepended with
'xtce:' and 'seds:' respectively. Changed the JTableHandler's column
resize method so that the row height recalculation is skipped if the
total number of rows gets larger than a specified value (300 rows is
used) - this prevents a delay when resizing a table with a large number
of rows. Updated CCDD.jar.Updated XTCE export to account for the command
header structure table having child tables. Updated the XTCE.jar and
EDS.jar libraries so that the XML tags are prepended with 'xtce:' and
'seds:' respectively. Changed the JTableHandler's column resize method
so that the row height recalculation is skipped if the total number of
rows gets larger than a specified value (300 rows is used) - this
prevents a delay when resizing a table with a large number of rows.
Updated CCDD.jar.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected null pointer error when a CSV file contains no table
definition. Updated the array size formatting to removing leading '+'
and zeroes. Changed the array size constraint to allow an array size of
1 (was >=2) for each dimension. Changed so that a macro may be used in a
sizeof() call (the formula in the sizeof() call must evaluate to a valid
data type). Changed so that when the macro pop-up is invoked the text
has parentheses temporarily added so that the parentheses are balanced,
allowing the macro to be validated. Changed so that certain CSV file
tags allow both singular and plural forms during import (export outputs
only the singular form). Updated user's guide, Javadoc, and CCDD.jar
(version 1.4.66).

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Corrected exception when dragging a tab from one pane to another.
Changed CSV and JSON import into an existing table to use the existing
table's table type definition to determine value placement in columns.
Updated XTCE import to handle files created by XTCE export. (in work)
Adding script access methods and script to perform XTCE export.

author: Russell K. McCluney <r.k.mccluney@nasa.gov>
message:
Changed the table search tree so that headers (node, type) can be
selected. Corrected table path construction in the field table editor
and updated the table search to allow headers. Changed table
modification so that SQL commands that used OR'd conditions are now
issued as individual commands (significant postgres speed improvement).
Changed links and telemetry scheduler table updates to detect array
deletions so that a single command can be constructed to remove all
array members. Updated cFE command and telemetry structure CSV import
files. Updated user's guide and CCDD.jar.
